## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 去重取最新值 (每用户每天多条记录时)
SELECT grass_date, user_id,
       MAX(predict_income_level) AS predict_income_level,
       MAX(predict_gender) AS predict_gender
FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
  AND grass_date >= DATE('2024-11-23')
GROUP BY grass_date, user_id

-- 构造用户标签字符串
SELECT CONCAT(predict_gender, '#', predict_age_group, '#', predict_ip_city) AS tag
FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. 构建用户年龄性别画像 (dws_target_audience_user_profile)

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW user_tags_age_gender AS
SELECT
    user_id,
    CASE WHEN predict_age_group IS NULL THEN 0
         WHEN predict_age_group > 3 THEN 3
         ELSE predict_age_group END AS age,
    CASE WHEN predict_gender = 'Male' THEN 2
         WHEN predict_gender = 'Female' THEN 1
         ELSE 0 END AS gender,
    grass_region, grass_date
FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = date'${yesterday}';
```

### 2. 构建受众定向标签bitmap (ads_target_audience_tags)

```sql
SELECT user_id, hash_id, predict_gender
FROM (SELECT user_id,
             NTILE(${hash_size}) OVER (ORDER BY user_id) AS hash_id,
             predict_gender, predict_age_group
      FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
      WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
        AND grass_date = date'${yesterday}') ordered_user_ids
WHERE predict_gender IS NOT NULL;
```

### 4. AB 实验效果分析

```sql
SELECT predict_income_level, predict_gender,
       SUM(cost_local) / SUM(advv_local) AS costRatio
FROM (
    SELECT a.user_id, a.grass_date,
           MAX(b.predict_income_level) AS predict_income_level,
           MAX(b.predict_gender) AS predict_gender,
           SUM(a.expenditure_amt_local) AS cost_local,
           SUM(a.broad_gmv_amt_local * a.target_cir) AS advv_local
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live a
    JOIN (
        SELECT grass_date, user_id,
               MAX(predict_income_level) AS predict_income_level,
               MAX(predict_gender) AS predict_gender
        FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
        WHERE grass_region = 'ID'
          AND grass_date >= DATE('2024-11-23')
        GROUP BY grass_date, user_id
    ) b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
    WHERE a.tz_type = 'local' AND a.placement IN (40)
    GROUP BY a.user_id, a.grass_date
)
GROUP BY predict_income_level, predict_gender;
```

### 5. 品牌广告用户标签映射

```sql
SELECT user_id,
       CONCAT_WS('-', age_group,
           CASE WHEN gender LIKE 'Male' THEN '1'
                WHEN gender LIKE 'Female' THEN '2'
                ELSE '0' END) AS user_tag,
       grass_date, grass_region
FROM (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, user_id,
           IF(predict_gender IS NULL, 'UNKOWN', predict_gender) AS gender,
           IF(predict_age_group IS NULL, 0, predict_age_group) AS age_group
    FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
    WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
      AND grass_region IN ('BR')
);
```

### 6. 展示广告用户标签融合

```sql
SELECT IF(a.user_id IS NULL, b.user_id, a.user_id) AS user_id,
       IF(predict_gender IS NULL, 'UNKOWN', predict_gender) AS gender,
       IF(predict_age_group IS NULL, 0, predict_age_group) AS age_group,
       IF(all_interested_l1_cate_ids_30d IS NULL, NULL, all_interested_l1_cate_ids_30d) AS all_l1_interested_cates
FROM (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, user_id, predict_gender, predict_age_group
    FROM mpi_data_mart.dws_a180_user_basic_predict_tags_df
    WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
) a
FULL OUTER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, user_id, all_interested_l1_cate_ids_30d
    FROM mpi_data_mart.adm_all_user_display_ads_custom_audience_targeting_tags_reg_df
    WHERE grass_date = '${BIZ_PRE_DAY}'
) b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region;
```
